s.session_type = 'h_as' AND s.parent_session_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(s.state, 'ACTIVE') IN ('ACTIVE', 'CLOSED') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM byai_session_ext e WHERE e.session_id = s.session_id AND e.ext_param_code = 'group_source_session_id' AND e.ext_param_value = CAST(s.parent_session_id AS VARCHAR(32))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM byai_group_chat_task t WHERE t.task_session_id = s.session_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM byai_group_chat_execution x WHERE x.candidate_session_id = s.session_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM byai_group_chat_turn r WHERE r.candidate_session_id = s.session_id OR r.gateway_session_id = CAST(s.session_id AS VARCHAR(32)))
SELECT t.task_session_id, t.group_session_id, t.initiator_user_id FROM byai_group_chat_task t WHERE UNION ALL SELECT s.session_id, s.parent_session_id, s.creator_id FROM byai_session s WHERE
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN t.turn_status = 'PRIVATE' THEN 'PRIVATE' ELSE t.status END, t.initiator_user_id, t.target_agent_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN b.task_session_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN t.status = 'PRIVATE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.create_time, t.task_session_id ) AS private_rank FROM byai_group_chat_task t LEFT JOIN byai_group_chat_direct_binding b ON b.task_session_id = t.task_session_id WHERE t.group_session_id = #{groupSessionId} AND ((t.status != 'PRIVATE' AND t.turn_status != 'PRIVATE') OR ( AND t.initiator_user_id = #{userId} AND )) ) visible WHERE (status != 'PRIVATE' AND turn_status != 'PRIVATE') OR private_rank = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC, task_session_id DESC

SELECT t.* FROM byai_group_chat_direct_binding b JOIN byai_group_chat_task t ON t.task_session_id = b.task_session_id AND t.group_session_id = b.group_session_id AND t.initiator_user_id = b.initiator_user_id AND t.target_agent_id = b.target_agent_id WHERE b.group_session_id = #{groupId} AND b.initiator_user_id = #{userId} AND b.target_agent_id = #{agentId} AND AND

SELECT t.* FROM byai_group_chat_task t WHERE t.group_session_id = #{groupId} AND t.initiator_user_id = #{userId} AND t.target_agent_id = #{agentId} AND AND ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.status = 'PRIVATE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.create_time, t.task_session_id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO byai_group_chat_direct_binding (group_session_id, initiator_user_id, target_agent_id, task_session_id) VALUES (#{groupSessionId}, #{initiatorUserId}, #{targetAgentId}, #{taskSessionId})
mapper.update: UPDATE byai_group_chat_task SET status = 'PRIVATE', update_time = #{now} WHERE task_session_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'CANCELLED' AND turn_status = 'PRIVATE'
UPDATE byai_session SET state = 'ACTIVE', update_time = #{now} WHERE session_id = #{taskId} AND state = 'CLOSED'

UPDATE byai_group_chat_task SET status = 'PUBLISHED', turn_status = 'WAITING_USER', publish_message_id = #{messageId}, publish_by = #{publisherUserId}, update_time = #{now} WHERE task_session_id = #{taskSessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND turn_status != 'RUNNING'
UPDATE byai_group_chat_task SET status = 'CANCELLED', update_time = #{now} WHERE task_session_id = #{taskSessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
